title: 第一卷 第3章 挣钱养家第一卷 第4章 刀光映月壮志初燃
slug: 武道长生从猎户开始刷熟练度修行
lines: 晨雾未散，林间已有樵夫砍柴的斧痕、采药人的足迹，以及附近猎户布设的陷阱痕迹。
秦猛循着猎人踩出的小径往深处走，腐叶混着泥土的气息扑面而来，虫鸣鸟叫，涧水潺潺。
“这感官……”
秦猛啧啧称奇。
原身虽然荒唐，但早年打熬的底子倒还在，耳目之灵敏远超预料。
他放轻脚步，抽箭搭弦，气息收敛得近乎于无。
前行二十余步，前方草丛骤晃。
箭出如电，没入草丛——
一声凄厉怪叫炸起，紧接着草叶疯狂摇动。
一只长尾雉鸡竟带着箭矢窜出，翅羽乱拍，鲜血飞溅，非但没有立即倒下，反而扑腾着逃窜。
秦猛一怔，急忙追上前。
那雉鸡垂死挣扎，力道惊人，连窜带飞竟又逃出三四丈远，才最终力竭倒地，羽翼仍在微微抽搐。
他快步上前，拎起掂了掂，足有五六斤重，箭矢深深嵌入其胸背，拔下时带出一股温热血腥。
与此同时，一股比预期中更明显的暖流自掌心涌入体内。
一行小字浮现：【命源+0.8%】
“命源？”
秦猛心头一动，查看意识中的面板，依旧是没有显示，体内却多了一缕奇异暖流。
这能量微弱，却在持续滋养着身体。
他精神一振，将山鸡放血后扔进背篓，继续向前搜寻。
林子外围山鸡野兔不少，却异常机警。
秦猛几次悄然靠近，还未拉满弓弦，草丛中便是一阵急促窜动，只留下晃动的枝叶。
这里的动物似乎对危险有着超乎寻常的直觉，动作快得惊人。
即便成功瞄准，箭矢破空而去，也未必能一击毙命。
一只灰野兔被射中后腿，竟拖着箭矢狂奔，秦猛连追数十步，最后不得不补上一箭才结果它。
山林树木葱茏，藤蔓交错，严重阻碍视野与箭路。
有时明明看见猎物，却因一根横生的枝桠而错失良机。
秦猛不得不更谨慎地选择站位与角度。
狩猎远非易事。
半个时辰下来，秦猛仅射中三只山鸡、两只野兔，又用石子打下七八只斑鸠。
连珠箭的熟练度在一次次失败与调整中艰难提升。
每次猎物毙命后，一丝温热的能量飘来融入体内，命源值跳动增加0.1%至0.6%不等。
体型越大，越是凶猛的猎物提供的命源也就越多。
“果然，猎杀生灵可汲取其消散的生命能量……但此间的野兽，体型更大，生命力格外顽强。”
content_en:
The morning fog has not yet dispersed, and there are already traces of the woodcutter's axe, the footprints of the herb collector, and the traps set by nearby hunters in the forest.
Qin Meng followed the path trodden by the hunter and walked deeper. The smell of rotten leaves mixed with earth hit his face, the chirping of insects and birds, and the gurgling of water.
"This sense..."
Qin Meng clicked his tongue in surprise.
Although the original person is ridiculous, the foundation of his early years of hard work is still there, and his ears and eyes are far more sensitive than expected.
He stepped lightly, drew his arrows, and drew his breath to the point of being almost nonexistent.
After walking forward for more than twenty steps, the grass ahead suddenly shook.
"Whoosh!"
The arrow shot out like lightning and disappeared into the grass——
"Gah-gah!"
A shrill scream exploded, followed by the blades of grass shaking crazily.
A long-tailed pheasant jumped out with an arrow, its wing feathers flapped wildly, and blood splattered. Instead of falling down immediately, it fluttered and fled.
Qin Meng was startled and hurriedly caught up.
The pheasant struggled to its death with astonishing strength. It even fled three or four feet away before finally falling to the ground exhausted, its wings still twitching slightly.
He quickly stepped forward, picked it up and weighed it. It weighed five or six kilograms. The arrow was deeply embedded in his chest and back, and when he pulled it out, it brought out a stream of warm blood.
At the same time, a more obvious warmth than expected poured into the body from the palm of his hand.
A line of small words appeared: [Life source +0.8%]
"Source of life?"
Qin Meng's heart moved and he checked the panel in his consciousness. There was still no display, but there was a strange warmth in his body.
This energy is weak, but it continues to nourish the body.
He regained his energy, bled the pheasant, threw it into his backpack, and continued his search.
There are many pheasants and hares on the outskirts of the forest, but they are extremely alert.
Qin Meng quietly approached several times, but before he could fully draw the bow string, there was a rapid movement in the grass, leaving only the swaying branches and leaves.
The animals here seem to have an extraordinary sense of danger and their movements are astonishingly fast.
Even if you successfully aim and the arrow shoots through the air, it may not be enough to kill you with one hit.
A gray hare was shot in the hind leg and ran wildly, dragging the arrow with it. Qin Meng chased it for dozens of steps, and finally had to add another arrow to kill it.
The mountains and forests are lush with trees and intertwined vines, seriously obstructing the view and arrow paths.
Sometimes the prey is clearly seen, but the opportunity is missed because of an overgrown branch.
Qin Meng had to choose his position and angle more carefully.
Hunting is far from easy.
After half an hour, Qin Meng only shot three pheasants and two hares, and also used stones to kill seven or eight turtle doves.
The proficiency of Lianzhu Arrow was difficult to improve through repeated failures and adjustments.
Every time the prey dies, a trace of warm energy floats into the body, and the vitality value increases by 0.1% to 0.6%.
The larger and more ferocious the prey, the more life sources it provides.
"Sure enough, hunting creatures can absorb their dissipated life energy...but the beasts here are larger and have extremely tenacious vitality."
